News

2026-09-16

A system maintenance will be performed on EQUASIS on the 18 of September between 10:00 and 12:00 (UTC).
Equasis service will not be available during this interval.
The EQUASIS support team apologizes for any inconvenience this may cause.

News

2026-07-20

Equasis held its 46th Editorial Board meeting remotely, where discussions covered the review of the Data Providers Accreditation Procedure, the potential expansion of the scope of data provision by data providers, and the progress made in developing training material for users.
At the end of the meeting, elections were held for the positions of Chair and the Vice-Chair positions of the Editorial Board for the next two-years term.
